upgrade.freeDesc: For trying PhD Atlas with a small shortlist.
upgrade.proDesc: For active application seasons with more programs and safer backups.
upgrade.proFeatureAutomation: Manual backups, recycle bin recovery, and 100 MB storage
upgrade.teamDesc: For advisors and agencies managing a roster of students, with teacher and student seats.
upgrade.introTitle: The same workspace, with more headroom.
upgrade.introDesc: Your applications, dossiers, checklists, and timelines stay exactly where they are. Pro only removes the limits around them.
upgrade.benefitBackupBody: Choose automatic backup from every minute to daily, or create a snapshot before a major edit.
upgrade.benefitSafetyBody: Restore an application or an earlier snapshot without rebuilding the record.
upgrade.benefitSeasonBody: Keep a serious shortlist active in one workspace—up to 300 applications.
upgrade.benefitMemberBody: Keep application documents and attachments beside the record that uses them.
upgrade.flowDesc: Send the Pro request email. After approval, sign in again and the new limits are ready.
upgrade.stepRequest: Send a Pro access request from this page.
upgrade.stepReview: An administrator confirms the account and plan.
upgrade.stepActivate: Sign in again; Pro capacity and recovery controls are ready.
